situations.headline: BUPA redirects international telehealth referrals away from Doctors on Demand, ~$6m FY27 revenue hit

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: BUPA redirects international telehealth referrals away from Doctors on Demand, ~$6m FY27 revenue hit (interest 6, risk 5)

thesis.text: Vitura's Doctors on Demand unit faces a material, partner-driven revenue shock (~$6m FY27) from BUPA redirecting international-member telehealth traffic to a platform BUPA has a financial stake in, despite prior volume assurances; the breach notice signals a live commercial dispute whose resolution (financial remedy, contract renegotiation, or litigation) is the near-term catalyst, while management's reaffirmed FY2027 improvement claim (unquantified) should be tested against other segment performance (Canview, Cannadoc, Releaf) as the group's earnings mix shifts away from BUPA-linked telehealth.
